action_input.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_commander_cards,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hasContentWarning = 0 OR hasContentWarning IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_content_warning,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN hasContentWarning = 0 OR hasContentWarning IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 10) as percentage_no_warning
FROM cards 
WHERE setCode LIKE 'C%' AND setCode IS NOT NULL
